richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Gorakhpur

c: Ramgarh Tal gives Gorakhpur a lakeside promenade, and walkers along it are exactly the people an outdoor gym is for. Parks, colleges, railway colonies, schools and housing societies across the city have the same morning crowd. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to all these buyers, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,160 km from Gorakhpur, and delivered by road.

Eastern Uttar Pradesh has hot summers, a heavy monsoon and cold winters, and the Rapti floods low ground in some years. We plan each gym on a raised, drained base and choose the installation method to suit your soil. Our installation team or a dealer in north India does the work after you approve a layout drawing. Send us the site measurements, a few photos and an idea of how many people use the space each day.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be placed on ground that floods?
items.a: Where you can, raise the gym area above the usual water level and grout each base. If water does reach the machines, rinse off the silt and check the bearings once it recedes.

items.q: How should machines be spaced along a walking path?
items.a: Spread them out so walkers meet a station every so often, with a clear zone around each one that does not block the path. We show this on the layout drawing.
Yes. We manufacture in Vasai, send the machines by road and install them through our own team or a dealer in north India, grouted or self-standing.
